Sync.//: Cloud sync. Leave everything as it is and the feature disappears from Settings, which is the right state for a fork of this repo.
Sync.// ProxyUrl: The way to turn it on. Deploy workers/sync-proxy, put the Supabase URL and anon key in it as secrets, and paste the worker's address here. The app then carries no key, and calls over the rate are refused before Supabase is reached. Add the worker's host to connect-src in index.html as well.
Sync.// Url: The direct path, kept for a fork that would rather not run a worker. Fill Url and AnonKey instead, run db/sync.sql in the Supabase SQL editor, and add the project host to connect-src. The anon key is public the moment it ships -- it grants nothing without a pairing code, but it does let anyone call the project at any rate they like, which is what the proxy exists to stop.

Notice.//: The bar above every page, for the things the app cannot work out for itself: an outage, a feature that has started failing, or a pack that launched before the card database published it. Leave GistUrl blank and no request is made and no authored notice can appear -- the app still shows the ones it derives from its own data.
Notice.// GistUrl: A gist's raw URL, WITHOUT the revision SHA so it always serves the latest edit: https://gist.githubusercontent.com/you/<gist-id>/raw/notice.json. A gist rather than a file in this repo because the service worker precaches every .json in the published output and then serves it cache-first forever, so a committed notice would be frozen at whichever build the visitor installed. Add the host to connect-src in index.html as well.
Notice.// contents: A LIST, even for one notice: [{"id":"2026-09-18-b5","level":"info","text":"B5 launches today. The card database has not published it yet.","until":"2026-09-25"}]. id is required and is what a dismissal is remembered against, so reuse it for edits and change it for a new notice. level is info, warning or problem. until is inclusive yyyy-MM-dd and optional -- but an unreadable date drops the notice, because that field is the only thing that makes one stop. actionLabel and actionHref are optional and both-or-nothing; the href must be an absolute https URL or a relative in-app path.
